subject: gk
question: As of 15th March 2021, how many women judges are there in the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• First, three women judges were sworn in as the Supreme Court judges on 31 August 2021, including **Justice BV Nagarathna who is in line to be the first female Chief Justice of India (CJI) in September 2027.**
 
• With this, the Supreme Court of India has **four sitting women judges, the highest ever in history.**
 
• The** first female justice in the court was Fathima Beevi **who was appointed on October 6, 1989.
 
• Since then, 11 female justices have been in the court.
